newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin price down one cent to 13.70 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin price down one cent to 13.70 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended a cent lower at 13.70 ringgit ($5.43) a kg on Tuesday after sellers crowded the market despite an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There were heavy offerings, although the LME was higher, and buying came just under the selling level," said a trader.
Traders said the market's immediate resistance was at 13.80 ringgit while support was seen at 13.60.
Offers outnumbered bids by 147 tonnes to 114 on Tuesday. Turnover totalled 128 tonnes against the 118 on Monday. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
The local premium against London fell to $15 from $30.
